app-templates.message:
docs(interactive): the architecture of every interactive app, in arc42

## Intent

Interactive apps need a real architecture, not only a template to copy: frontend-only apps with a static description and an optional client-side tutor. It should guide a very free agent early.

## Key changes

- A first arc42 architecture in the interactive template, in English and minimal, in all twelve chapters.
- It describes apps that run only in the browser, with a start page readable without JavaScript, an app page and an optional tutor.
- Quality goals: nothing leaves the device without a click, everything replays from seed and inputs, accessible by default with declared limits.
- Building blocks for the runtime (start page, shell, build checks, tutor bridge) and the app (core, view, data, playthroughs), with interfaces; an app hangs its own blocks below core and view.
- How the tutor works is marked as proposed, not decided.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Rebuilt with the arc42 guide in the next commit of app-templates#34 (i109).
